name: bench-numpy-parallel
description: Same as pipeline-numpy, but the Python stage runs 2 instances. Only legal because py.bench-numpy declares maxParallelism 4 — it computes a mean per frame and keeps no state, so replicating it cannot diverge. NOTE: parallelism multiplies the frames in flight (edge queue + work queue + executing + reorder), so it needs arena slots to match; 2 instances fit the default 8-slot arena, 4 do not until slot count is derived from the graph. Compare against pipeline-numpy with MODE=pipelined.
